info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Telecom Sim Portability-v2-spec
info.description: The Telecom Sim Portability API facilitates the bulk submission of requests for mobile number portability, allowing users to seamlessly transition their telephone numbers between different telecom providers. This endpoint enables service providers or authorized entities to collectively process multiple portability transactions in a single operation, enhancing efficiency and customer experience. Typical consumers include telecom companies and customer service platforms managing portability requests. Use this API to streamline the management of SIM portability and improve service delivery times.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to start the process of SIM portability, enabling them to transfer their mobile number from one carrier to another seamlessly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a portability operation for a SIM card. The payload must conform to the defined JSON schema and should include all necessary parameters for successful processing.
